generator.defaults.cone_offset.note: A Macrozamia bears several cones round its crown among the leaf bases, to a hundred in M. moorei (Whitelock 2002, p. 248, 250): half the trunk's radius out.

generator.defaults.ripe_lean.note: Macrozamia communis's female cones stand erect, then droop when mature (Whitelock 2002, p. 250): seventy degrees from upright.

generator.defaults.cone_seeds.note: A Macrozamia's female cone, 20 to 45 cm in M. communis (Whitelock 2002, p. 250), shows forty seeds as it breaks up (estimated).

appearance.note: A Macrozamia's sporophyll face ends in one sharp, flat, erect spine, longest toward the cone's apex: in M. communis 1 to 2.5 cm at the female cone's foot to 4 to 8 cm at its apex, and 0.1 to 5 cm on the male's (Whitelock 2002, p. 18-19, 250); drawn as shares of a cone's length.
